types.label: Host API down
types.description: The console cannot reach the host API: every part that runs on the VPS host can't be seen or driven (the units keep running).

types.label: Host service down
types.description: A console part that runs on the VPS host (builds-live, shipped-features, hub sync, agent jobs, host checks, maintenance, the lander or a watchdog) stopped; its Auto fix restarts the unit.
